name: Subs
subtitle: Subscription calendar
description: Official source for Subs, a calendar for your subscriptions.

apps.name: Subs
apps.subtitle: See every subscription on a calendar.
apps.localizedDescription:
Track your subscriptions on a monthly calendar. See what is due each day, what you spend per month and year, and get reminded before renewals.

Import from JSON, App Store receipts or bank statements. Logos are fetched automatically.

Note: iCloud sync is not available in sideloaded builds; data stays on the device.

versions.localizedDescription: Currency-aware amounts and fixes for ended plans and exchange rates. Fuller backups. Safer logo fetching. Keypad uses your decimal separator. The day sheet updates live. Confirmations before deleting categories, lists or adding samples. Larger-text support. Performance improvements.
Data fixes (pauses, refunds, 3-decimal currencies), reliable reminders, VoiceOver support, cleaner design, faster imports and calendar.
